en.title: Shooting Line Keypad Scoring
en.excerpt: Detailed guide to entering arrow values with target keypads, automatic value ordering, end totals, and athlete confirmation.
en.content:
Keypad Layout & Arrow Values

The Archeris scoring interface features high-contrast, color-coded buttons designed for one-thumb field operation:

  • Gold Buttons (X & 10): 10 points. 'X' is recorded separately for tie-breaker calculations.
  • Gold Button (9): 9 points.
  • Red Buttons (8 & 7): 8 and 7 points.
  • Blue Buttons (6 & 5): 6 and 5 points.
  • Black Buttons (4 & 3): 4 and 3 points.
  • White Buttons (2 & 1): 2 and 1 points.
  • Green Button (M): Miss (0 points).

Recording End-by-End Scores

Select the athlete tab (e.g., Archer 1A). Tap the buttons corresponding to each arrow called by the archers at the target face (e.g., X, 10, 9, 9, 8, 7). Repeat for Archers 1B, 1C, and 1D.

Automatic Descending Value Sorting

In accordance with World Archery rules, arrow values within an end are automatically sorted in descending order (highest to lowest) upon input.

Athlete Verification & End Submission

Allow the archers at the butt to visually review their end totals and cumulative score on the screen before tapping Save & Next End.
